description: Grid mode (C1, item 4): 4 panels with different colourings; linked cameras; hover in panel 3; lasso across panels; PNG export. Camera pan is verified programmatically (deck.gl's OrbitController does not respond to Playwright drag events in SwiftShader mode; real user drag is validated in the Positron e2e test).
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 2000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (3, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, n)

all 4 panels have non-background pixels (points rendered in every panel)

steps.name: panel 0 (cluster colours) and panel 1 (score gradient) have different dominant colour
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const W = cv.width, H = cv.height; const ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); function avgRed(x0,y0,w,h){ const d=ctx.getImageData(x0,y0,w,h).data; let s=0,n=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){ if(d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2]>60){s+=d[i];n++;} } return n>0?s/n:0; } const hw=Math.floor(W/2), hh=Math.floor(H/2); window.__red0=avgRed(0,0,hw,hh); window.__red1=avgRed(hw,0,W-hw,hh)
steps.report: { avgRedPanel0: window.__red0.toFixed(1), avgRedPanel1: window.__red1.toFixed(1), diff: Math.abs(window.__red0 - window.__red1).toFixed(1) }

steps.name: linked cameras: all 4 panel viewports show the same relative position for a world point
steps.eval: const ax = a.anchorXY[0], ay = a.anchorXY[1]; const vps = a.renderer.deck.getViewports(); window.__linkRelPos = vps.map(vp => ({ id: vp.id, relX: parseFloat(vp.project([ax, ay])[0].toFixed(2)), relY: parseFloat(vp.project([ax, ay])[1].toFixed(2)) }))

steps.name: programmatic camera pan propagates to all 4 panels (linked camera invariant maintained)
steps.eval: const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; const tgt = vs.target || [0,0,0]; const newVs = { ...vs, target: [tgt[0] + 2, tgt[1] + 1, tgt[2] || 0] }; a.renderer['viewState'] = newVs; const keyed = {}; for (let pi = 0; pi < 4; pi++) keyed['panel-' + pi] = newVs; a.renderer.deck.setProps({ viewState: keyed }); const ax = a.anchorXY[0], ay = a.anchorXY[1]; await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const vps2 = a.renderer.deck.getViewports(); window.__afterRelPos = vps2.map(vp => ({ id: vp.id, relX: parseFloat(vp.project([ax, ay])[0].toFixed(2)), relY: parseFloat(vp.project([ax, ay])[1].toFixed(2)) }))
steps.report: { before: window.__linkRelPos[0], after: window.__afterRelPos[0], delta: { x: (window.__afterRelPos[0].relX - window.__linkRelPos[0].relX).toFixed(1), y: (window.__afterRelPos[0].relY - window.__linkRelPos[0].relY).toFixed(1) } }

steps.name: hover in panel 3 (bottom-right) using its viewport's projected coordinates finds a nearby anchor row
steps.eval: const ax = a.anchorXY[0], ay = a.anchorXY[1]; const vps = a.renderer.deck.getViewports(); const vp3 = vps.find(v => v.id === 'panel-3') || vps[vps.length - 1]; const sc = vp3.project([ax, ay]); a['onPointer']({ x: vp3.x + sc[0], y: vp3.y + sc[1], world: [ax, ay] })
